description: Launch emulator and run lvglanimation
command: python3 -c "
import os, pty, subprocess, time, select

m, s = pty.openpty()
proc = subprocess.Popen(['./emulator.sh', 'cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/'],
                         stdin=s, stdout=s, stderr=s, close_fds=True)
os.close(s)

def read_until_prompt(m, prompt=b'nsh> ', timeout=30):
    data = b''
    end = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < end:
        r, _, _ = select.select([m], [], [], 0.5)
        if r:
            chunk = os.read(m, 4096)
            data += chunk
            if prompt in data:
                return data
    return data

# Wait for NSH prompt
print('Waiting for NSH...')
output = read_until_prompt(m, timeout=30)
print(output.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')[-500:])

# Run lvglanimation
print('Starting lvglanimation...')
os.write(m, b'lvglanimation\r\n')
time.sleep(5)

# Read some output
r, _, _ = select.select([m], [], [], 1)
if r:
    try:
        out = os.read(m, 4096)
        print(out.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
    except:
        pass

print('lvglanimation launched. PID:', proc.pid)
print('Emulator window should show the animation.')
" 2>&1
